events.title: Prescott Park & Market Square
events.blurb: The waterfront park across Marcy Street from Strawbery Banke, a short walk from the historic shops and cafés around Market Square.
events.blurbEs: El parque junto al agua frente a Strawbery Banke, a pocos pasos de las tiendas y cafés históricos alrededor de Market Square.

events.title: Alan Menken's A Christmas Carol
events.blurb: The Rep's family holiday musical runs through Dec. 20; check the ticket page for this weekend's showtimes.
events.blurbEs: El musical navideño familiar del Rep sigue hasta el 20 de diciembre; consulta los horarios de este fin de semana en la página de entradas.

events.title: A Christmas Carol
events.blurb: The Players' Ring opens its 90-minute Dickens adaptation Saturday; seating is unassigned and there is no late seating.
events.blurbEs: The Players' Ring estrena el sábado su adaptación de Dickens de 90 minutos; los asientos no son numerados y no se permite entrar tarde.

events.title: Lyle Brewer
events.blurb: The Berklee guitarist plays fingerstyle, jazz and folk instrumentals from his new album. General admission; doors and dinner service at 5:30.
events.blurbEs: El guitarrista de Berklee toca instrumentales de fingerstyle, jazz y folk de su nuevo álbum. Entrada general; puertas y servicio de cena a las 5:30.

events.title: Nate Smith
events.blurb: The jazz drummer and composer plays two Saturday sets at the supper club.
events.blurbEs: El baterista y compositor de jazz ofrece dos pases el sábado en el club.

events.title: Jimmy's Jazz Brunch: Johanna Landis Trio
events.blurb: A Sunday buffet brunch with omelet stations and a Bloody Mary bar, plus live jazz; last seating 1:30 and reservations are recommended.
events.blurbEs: Un brunch tipo bufé el domingo con estaciones de omelets y barra de Bloody Mary, más jazz en vivo; último turno a la 1:30 y se recomienda reservar.
